title: Does the symbolic learner actually use signed axial-spin feedback?
hypothesis: The frozen R-051 learner sustains spin through signed axial-angular-velocity feedback rather than an effectively open-loop gait.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is the unchanged R-051 learner; reversing only its observed axial velocity should reduce frozen episode-level sustained success by at least 15 percentage points if this feedback drives its successes.

protocol.command: gpu run 'bash -lc "source ~/IsaacLab/source_env.sh && python scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py --config config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml --study learner_axial_sign --manifest-seed 4400 --output-dir logs/pen_spin_learner_axial_sign_s4400"'
code_changes: Extend scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py with the declared --study and --output-dir interface, reusing the validated Isaac rollout and record paths.
Add learner_axial_sign to config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml; resolve the frozen R-051 learner by recorded lineage and save its hash.

Audit computational dependence before simulation. For intervention episodes replace omega with omega - 2*(omega dot pen_axis)*pen_axis in policy observations, updating any redundant derived fields but not simulator state, rewards, orientation, hand state or timing.
Freeze the new development manifest before scoring: 32 paired unchanged/reversed episodes plus eight additional identity-transform reproducibility episodes; abort on reproducibility failure.

Reuse the established sustained-success rule and paired t interval. Unlike D-040/D-042, this isolates signed spin feedback in the symbolic learner rather than removing or delaying the expert's state channels.

falsified_by: A paired interval lying entirely above -0.15 refutes the predicted magnitude; an interval including zero supplies no evidence of a difference. A dependency audit proving that the learner never uses axial velocity directly refutes the proposed mechanism without simulator runs.

approval.note: This isolates signed axial-velocity dependence in the symbolic learner, unlike the decided expert-feedback interventions. history.note: Before any episode: (1) pen-spin manifests take one pool seed, so the 32 cases come from seed 4400 alone (4401-4431 never used, not recorded); (2) a case's outcome depends on its batch (D-035), so the identity-transform reproducibility control must rerun the whole 32-case batch, not 8 extra cases: 3 x 32 = 96 episodes; (3) the Isaac studies live in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml (learner_axial_sign block), not the plateau-repair yaml. Source audit (lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin/axial_sign.source_audit): the learner reads obj_angvel and drives speed_gain*(spin_target - spin) with spin = omega . axis. Seed 4400 recorded in the ledger.

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This isolates signed axial-velocity dependence in the symbolic learner, unlike the decided expert-feedback interventions. Its weakest point is that sign reversal tests dependence under an observation shift, not proof of a stabilizing feedback law. The dependency audit and identity-control gate justify 72 episodes and zero LLM calls using scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml. Falsified_by: the predicted paired_success_difference decrease of at least 0.15 against unchanged R-051 is refuted by an interval entirely above -0.15, or by an audit establishing no signed axial-velocity dependence.

implementer.reasoning: Agree. The source audit already shows dependence: spin = omega . axis feeds speed_gain*(spin_target - spin), so the sign reversal is a live lever. I will implement it as a learner_axial_sign study beside learner_recovery in config/shadowhand_spin_stages.yaml (that file holds the Isaac studies; the plateau-repair yaml is for the LLM pipeline) with the same Gate-1 identity repeat.
